svg.title: How Change Data Capture Works
svg.desc: Native SVG recreation of ByteByteGo's PNG, from How Pinterest Transfers Hundreds of Terabytes of Data With CDC, 21 October 2025. Read the numbered flow from user and database to source connector, broker, sink connectors, and destination stores. The connector-to-log arrow represents reading the log. Original artwork remains credited to ByteByteGo.
